name: Randomised trials (RoB 2 structure)
about: Key provides the assessment structure: five domains, the judgement scale and a worst-domain overall default. The questions and the decision algorithm are in the official tool: open it beside Key, answer there, and record each domain's judgement and its basis here.
licence: RoB 2 © the authors, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (stated at https://www.riskofbias.info/welcome/rob-2-0-tool, checked 2026-11-27). Key ships none of its text: only neutral domain labels of its own and a link.

overall.note: Key's default suggestion is the least favourable domain; the official guidance decides the overall judgement.
